# Every public path rastrillo.org publishes under /design-system/ today:
# the tree dsgen writes at v0.35.0, the version the site is synced to,
# without dsgen's .dsgen stamp and the content-hashed asset names
# (name.<16 hex>.ext). It keeps every page, preview frame, pt/ stub and
# plain asset name. Generated once, with:
#
#	git worktree add --detach $DIR v0.35.0
#	cd $DIR && go run ./cmd/dsgen -out $OUT -mount /design-system
#	cd $OUT && find . -type f | sed 's|^\./||' |
#	    grep -Ev '^\.dsgen$|^[^/]+\.[0-9a-f]{16}\.[a-z]+$' |
#	    sed 's|^|/design-system/|' | LC_ALL=C sort
